intent: Verify AppCDS dynamic archive behaviour on JDK 21 through 24 and adjust CacheStrategy
Verify dynamic AppCDS on JDK 21-24 in Docker and record the mismatch matrix

name: scripts/verify-appcds.sh
role: Runs the container script on eclipse-temurin 21-24 and passes the previous JDK's archive to the next run
conditions: Needs a running Docker daemon; prints tab-separated rows

name: docs/appcds-jdk-matrix.md
role: Records what each JVM does for each archive mismatch
conditions: Rerun the script when a new JDK release appears

subject: Silent archive rejection
why: With -Xshare:auto a large -Xmx or -XX:-UseCompressedClassPointers drops the archive with no log line; only -Xlog:class+load shows whether it was used

subject: JAR modification time
why: A byte-identical JAR with a new mtime invalidates the whole dynamic archive, so trainer and runtime need the same extracted files

title: Keep CacheStrategy unchanged: same dynamic AppCDS flags work on JDK 21-24
why: Behaviour was identical on 21, 22, 23 and 24 in every scenario, so a per-JDK branch would add code for a difference that does not exist
alternative: Static dump (-Xshare:dump) — rejected: two steps, and dynamic archives did not misbehave

title: Never pass -Xshare:on; rely on the default -Xshare:auto
why: Every mismatch under auto exits 0 and starts without the archive; under on it exits 1. A stale archive must not stop a pod
alternative: -Xshare:on to detect bad archives — rejected: fatal on every mismatch

title: Verify with a Docker shell script instead of a Java integration test
why: Four JDKs are needed; Docker supplies them without local installs on every machine and runner
alternative: JUnit test using locally installed JDKs — rejected: needs all four JDKs on every machine
